answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a trust garden: each identity earns reputation like a plant grows, and fake accounts start barren with no history. To join, a newcomer must stake collateral along a trellis of endorsements — reputable agents risk part of their own stake to vouch for it. If the identity cheats, the stake burns in a downward spiral for both the sybil and its sponsors, so honest agents vet carefully. An attacker needing hundreds of vouched identities must buy honest trust at scale, which costs more than the attack gains.
